description: Read every post currently waiting for an unconnected network (kept with drafts_hold), in full: its id, network, title, text, media ids, topic id, timestamps and account link. Optionally filter to one network. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

network.description: Filter to one network key, such as "instagram". Leave out to list every waiting post.

name: drafts_hold_list
title: List waiting posts
